name: parallel-gate-config-resolution
title: Parallel-decomposition gate config resolution in resolveAuditConfig (program Story 3)
description: Populate AuditConfig.parallelGate in core/audit-config.ts resolveAuditConfig per spec section 4.7: per-profile defaults (light: advise/2/false, balanced: advise/3/false, strict: block/4/true) plus a dedicated resolveParallelGate(raw, profileDefault) helper that validates the NESTED object field-by-field (mode against VALID_PARALLEL_MODES with console.warn + advise fallback; maxConcurrentReview integer-greater-equal-1 guard; broadGlobBlocks boolean; missing or non-object raw => all profile defaults). Resolution priority: per-field override in .lattice/audit-config.json, then profile default, then hardcoded fallback. Disjoint from Stories 4 and 5.
